description: Highest-quality brands for a supplement: one product per brand (its best), ranked by ProofMark, Aviado's product quality score (testing, ingredients, transparency, manufacturing, certifications). proofmark_100 is the 0-100 score (proofmark = proofmark_100/100) with a letter grade; proofmark_status is graded, below_coverage_floor (assessed but too little evidence to score; not a low score) or not_scored, and only graded products carry a score. Retired catalog products are excluded. match_basis says whether products matched the supplement identity or a text search (less precise; may include multi-ingredient products). price, retailer and product_url come from scraped listings and may be missing or stale. The supplement may be a name or an Aviado canonical_id (from search_supplements or a candidates list). Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.
name: get_top_brands
title: Top brands by ProofMark
